text:
sam: Heads-up — planning RFC review slot for Tue 11:00 AM PT (45m). Need authors to claim or swap by EOD Fri. If you can't make it, reply here or flag who can swap. Link to RFC: https://docs.internal/rfcs/1234

alex: I can attend Tue 11 but would prefer compacting to 30m: blockers + decision. Saves folks time. :clock3:

priya: I'm the author for RFC-1234. Tue 11 is OK but Tue 10 would be better for me (back-to-back blocked after 11). @sam can we see if a swap is possible?

sam: @priya noted. I'll check attendees. If someone can move, please ping here. Otherwise we can try to compress agenda to 30m.

marco: I have a design review at Tue 10 today but can try to push it later and swap to 10 if frontend agrees. Will confirm by 4pm.

jen: +1 to 30m. Pre-read uploaded: docs/rfcs/1234.md — TL;DR: change model routing on spike inference path, perf vs cost tradeoffs.

calendar-bot: Event created: "RFC Review — Tue 11:00 AM PT (45m)" — invites sent to #eng, owners: sam, priya.

priya: If we do 30m, can we handle follow-ups async? I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + questions in this thread by EOD.

sam: Sounds good. Draft agenda (if 30m):
1) 3m quick context / goals
2) 15m tradeoffs & perf numbers (author + infra)
3) 10m decision, action items, rollforward plan

alex: I'll take infra review and run the perf slide. @sam please add me to the event attendees.

marco: Swap confirmed with frontend — I can move my slot to Tue 10. Keeping this thread updated.

priya: Posted pre-read highlights below: 
- motivation: reduce tail latency for small requests
- change: route 15% of traffic to optimized path
- perf impact: ~8–12% cost reduction in perf tests, 5–10ms median improvement
- open Q: cache invalidation and canary threshold

sam: Nice summary. Can reviewers drop 1-line thumbs if they'll attend and have read pre-read?

alex: alex: :thumbsup: will attend and read.
jen: jen: :thumbsup: read; will focus on cache edge cases.

sam: Great — finalizing: Event remains Tue 11 but we'll compress to 30m. Priya, please post the two slides you want covered and one concrete decision ask. Everyone else, swap confirmations or objections by 4pm.

priya: Will do — posting slides in ~30m. Thanks all.
